verdict.rationale: Extend documents a dedicated test environment: test-mode API keys run extractions, classifications, and workflows against an isolated environment that never touches production data or fires production webhooks. This is true sandbox isolation, not a dry-run. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on test-environment limits or parity with production (e.g., credit usage, processor/data availability).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Use a test-mode API key to run extractions, classifications, and workflows against an isolated test environment with no production data or webhooks.
Runs made with a test API key never touch production data and never fire production webhooks
